profile.name: Sriram Rajakumar
profile.tagline: Engineering the unexpected. Code. Creativity. Curiosity.

projects.title: MeetMind
projects.description: An end-to-end AI meeting intelligence platform that turns raw transcripts into structured action items, decisions, risk registers, grounded Q&A, and automated follow-up communications — with strict anti-hallucination schema validation.

projects.title: The Common Room
projects.description: A full-stack residential maintenance platform with interactive 3D infographics (Three.js), role-based portals for residents and admins, real-time KPI dashboards, automated overdue tracking, immutable audit logs, and light/dark mode.

projects.title: DRDL Remote HPC Job Execution System
projects.description: A web-based platform for submitting and monitoring computational jobs on remote Linux servers over SSH with PBS/TORQUE-compatible scheduling and real-time diagnostics.

projects.title: Raga Lens
projects.description: An AI-powered Carnatic raga identification system built using deep learning models trained across 96 ragas, combining FastAPI, React, TensorFlow, and audio feature engineering.

projects.title: Campus Homie
projects.description: A community-driven platform built with React and Firebase that enables students and faculty to post help requests, discover resources, and connect with one another.

experience.title: Defence Research and Development Laboratory (DRDL), DRDO
experience.description: Designed and developed a remote HPC job execution and monitoring system that enables users to submit, monitor, and troubleshoot computational jobs running on remote Linux servers over SSH. The system supports PBS/TORQUE-compatible scheduling, live job monitoring, and intelligent diagnostics to simplify interaction with command-line HPC environments. Working in a research environment reinforced the importance of reliability, maintainability, and understanding systems beyond just writing code.

experience.title: Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL)
experience.description: Introduced to defence engineering workflows and Linux-based radar system testing. Working with mission-critical systems taught me to learn quickly, adapt to unfamiliar technologies, and appreciate the discipline required when software interacts with real-world hardware.

experience.title: Stellar (VIT Astronomy Club)
experience.description: Organized technical events, coordinated teams, mentored junior members, worked with sponsors, and contributed to workshops and community initiatives. These experiences strengthened my leadership, communication, and collaborative problem-solving skills just as much as my technical ones.

items.name: Prodapt Hackathon
items.details: Built MeetMind, an end-to-end AI meeting intelligence platform with structured extraction, anti-hallucination pipelines, and automated follow-up generation. Deployed backend on Render with full test coverage.

items.name: Unthinkable Hackathon
items.details: Built The Common Room, a full-stack residential maintenance platform with interactive 3D infographics (Three.js), role-based portals, transactional state machines, and automated overdue tracking. Deployed across Vercel, Render, and Neon Cloud.

items.name: IIM Indore Case Competitions
items.details: Finalist in both the Ashwamedha – A Legacy Leadership Competition and the B2C Marketing Case Competition at IIM Indore. These national-level challenges pushed me to approach complex problems from business, strategy, and leadership perspectives rather than purely technical ones.

items.name: Futurepreneurs
items.details: Secured 3rd Place in Futurepreneurs, a university-wide innovation competition focused on entrepreneurship, creativity, and practical problem-solving.
